title: Rearrange Spaces Between Words
summary: Given a string text containing words separated by spaces, rearrange the spaces so that there is an equal number of spaces between every pair of adjacent words, with the number of spaces being maximized.
statement: Given a string text containing words separated by spaces, rearrange the spaces so that there is an equal number of spaces between every pair of adjacent words, with the number of spaces being maximized. If it is not possible to distribute all the spaces equally, place the remaining spaces at the end of the string. Ensure the length of the output string matches the length of the input string.
constraints: Preserve word order and total string length.
Distribute spaces equally between adjacent words with the largest possible common gap, placing any remainder at the end.
reference_solution:
def redistribute_word_spaces(text):
 words=text.split();spaces=text.count(' ')
 if len(words)==1:return words[0]+' '*spaces
 gap,leftover=divmod(spaces,len(words)-1)
 return (' '*gap).join(words)+' '*leftover
hints: Count spaces and split out the words.
With multiple words, divide spaces by gaps=words-1.
Join using the quotient and append the remainder; with one word, append every space.
The quotient is the largest equal gap that uses no more than the available spaces.
editorial: The quotient is the largest equal gap that uses no more than the available spaces.

tests.explanation: Five spaces give one between each pair and two trailing spaces.
Six spaces across three words give three between each pair and none trailing.

arguments: walks  udp package   into  bar a
tests.expected: walks  udp  package  into  bar  a
